texts.zh:
信号似乎是从某个类似信号天线的结构中传来的。我方已经从[Root.GetName]发射了探索无人机，希望能够在星球表面发现更多线索。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]所发现的洞穴仓库十分容易地就被撬开。他判定这座仓库为某种早已灭亡的外星种族所用，似乎是其族群最后的一处避难所。该种族的科技水平虽然较为先进，但似乎从未进行太空探索，结果因为某种涉及到整颗星球的自然灾害而消亡了。库房面积广大，其中充斥着成千上万个黑匣子。据[Root.GetName]判定，这些匣子都是数据储存装置。

已发起特殊项目来进一步对这些匣子进行解读。
texts.en:
The signal originates from the remains of an antenna-like structure. Exploratory probes were dispatched from the [Root.GetName] to the surface to investigate the matter more closely.

What Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] found was a cavernous vault that, while easily pried open, was evidently the last safehouse and refuge of some long-dead race of aliens. While reasonably technologically advanced, it seems they never reached for the stars and perished to some planet-wide natural disaster. The vault is immense, housing thousands upon thousands of black boxes that the [Root.GetName] has determined to be data storage devices.

A Special Project has been prepared to decode their contents.

texts.zh:
此次发现的避难所原来是一个希望永生的物种的大型坟墓。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]判定，这些巨大的匣子中所充满的三进制编码，实际上是神经网路投影、数据化的脑部扫描结果。毫无疑问，[From.From.GetName]的异星物种认为这是他们在星球毁灭前唯一的存活方法。虽然他们无法拯救自己，但心中仍然希望着或许有一天，其它物种可以使用这些数据来复活他们。
texts.en:
The vault is a tomb for hopeful immortals.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] asserts that the huge blocks of ternary code found in the databanks are neural images - digitized brain scans. Doubtless the aliens of [From.From.GetName] considered this their only shot at any kind of survival, following whatever calamity befell their planet. They did not have the means to resurrect themselves, but banked on the impossibly small hope that eventually, someone else would have those means.

texts.zh:
此次发现的避难所原来是一个希望永生的物种的大型坟墓。

数据库中发现的大量三进制编码，实际上是神经网路投影、数据化的脑部扫描结果。毫无疑问，[From.From.GetName]的异星物种认为这是他们在星球毁灭前唯一的存活方法。虽然他们没有复活自己的技术，但仍然抱着终有一天会有其他文明帮他们做到的微小希望。

考虑到我们高度发达的机器人技术，研究员们确信我们的机器人拥有承载这种高等智慧的精密度。
texts.en:
The vault is a tomb for hopeful immortals.

The huge blocks of ternary code found in the databanks are neural images - digitized brain scans. Doubtless the aliens of [From.From.GetName] considered this to be their only shot at survival, following whatever calamity befell their planet. Lacking the means to resurrect themselves, they banked on the small hope that eventually, someone else would.

With our expertise in the field of advanced robotics, researchers are confident that our robots are sophisticated enough to support a higher intelligence.

texts.zh:
此次发现的避难所原来是一个希望永生的物种的大型坟墓。

这些数据库中充满了大段的三进制编码，其中储存着的是他们的生物中央处理单元。[From.From.GetName]的异星物种似乎认为这是他们唯一的幸存方法。虽然他们无法拯救自己，但仍希望着其它物种或许可以做到。

我们可以将这些神经扫描结果传输到我们的机器人身躯中，但这样的实验是很难预料其结果的。
texts.en:
The vault is a tomb for hopeful immortals.

Within its databanks lie massive blocks of ternary code, housing digitized scans of their biological central processing units. The aliens of [From.From.GetName] likely saw this as their only chance for survival. Unable to resurrect themselves, they hoped that someone else would.

We can transfer these neural scans into robotic bodies like ours, but the results of such an experiment are difficult to predict.

label.zh: 还是不要打扰死者了吧。
将神经模式下载到我们的数据库。
label.en: Download the neural patterns for safekeeping.

label.zh: 将他们的神经模式下载到人格仓库。
label.en: Download their neural patterns to the Identity Repository.

texts.zh: 在多次尝试与挫折之后，工程部门终于将已灭绝的外星人的神经扫描结果上传到了机器人中，结果十分令人惊喜。古代外星人已经彻底恢复了意识，并表达了加入我们帝国的意愿，他们希望在我们领地内的一个新星球上定居。
texts.en: After many trials and setbacks, the engineering department has finally managed to transfer the extinct aliens' neural scans to robotic bodies, and the results are exhilarating. The ancient aliens have fully regained consciousness and have expressed a desire to join our empire, offering to colonize a new planet within our borders.

label.en: It's better if we part ways.

title.zh: 生死弥留：线缆中的灵魂

texts.zh:
工程部门带回了令人高度担忧的消息。在“生死弥留”项目期限最后一天的工作中，科学家们再一次尝试将外星人的神经扫描结果上传到机器人身体的工作似乎还是失败了，但在第二天科学家们回来的时候，却发现那些机器人都不见了。

有些人猜测，上传尝试其实已经成功了，是外星人趁夜间瞧瞧出逃，也有人说这是个精心设计的骗局。我们看来是无从确认了……
texts.en:
The engineering department has returned with some highly disturbing news. After concluding the final day of "Project Limbo" with yet another seemingly failed attempt at uploading the alien neural scans to robotic bodies, the scientists returned the following day to find the robots missing.

Some believe the attempt succeeded after all and that the aliens stole away in the night, others that it's an elaborate hoax. We may never know for sure...

texts.zh: 随着我们在机器人学方面最近取得重大进展，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的科学家认为我们完全可以造出精密度足够承受更高级神经意识的合成躯体。我们可以将前一段时间从外星库房中回收的神经扫描图上传至机器人中，并让这些外星人由此复活。
texts.en: Following the recent advancements in the field of robotics, the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] is confident that we can produce synthetic bodies sophisticated enough to support a higher neurological consciousness. We could upload the neural patterns that were recovered from the alien vault discovered some time ago into robots, and bring the aliens back to life.

label.zh: 还是不要打扰死者了吧。

texts.zh: 那些外星人，在我们将其神经模式传输到机器人躯体以后，离开了我们的帝国。他们在某一个清晨聚集在一小群民用航天器上，设定了前往遥远星系的航线。到目前为止，我们还没有听到他们的回音，我们可能永远不会知道他们是否到达了目的地。
texts.en: The aliens, whose minds we uploaded to robotic bodies, have left. They gathered early one morning on a small fleet of civilian spacecraft, setting course for a distant star system. So far we haven't heard back from them and we may never learn whether they reached their destination.

texts.zh: 有报告称，意识被我们上传至机器人的外星人已经成功对一颗行星进行了殖民，他们现在自称“觉醒者”。
texts.en: Reports are coming in that the aliens, whose minds we uploaded to robotic bodies, have colonized a planet and now style themselves "the Awoken."

texts.zh: 在多次尝试之后，工程部门终于将灭绝的外星人的神经扫描结果上传到了机器人中，结果十分令人惊喜。古代外星人已经彻底恢复了意识，并表达了加入我们帝国的意愿，希望我们能够允许他们在我们领域内的一个新星球上进行殖民。
texts.en: After many trials the engineering department has finally managed to transfer the extinct aliens' neural scans to robotic bodies, and the results are exhilarating. The ancient aliens have fully regained consciousness and have expressed a desire to join our empire, requesting our permission to colonize a new planet within our borders.

label.en: It's better if we part ways.

texts.zh: 在多次尝试之后，工程部门终于将灭绝外星人的神经扫描结果上传到了机器人中，结果十分令人惊喜。古代外星人已经彻底恢复了意识，并表达了要重建自己帝国的意愿。
texts.en: After many trials the engineering department has finally managed to transfer the extinct aliens' neural scans to robotic bodies, and the results are exhilarating. The ancient aliens have fully regained consciousness and have expressed a desire to strike out on their own and rebuild their empire.

label.en: We won't stand in their way.

texts.zh: 在多次尝试之后，我们的工程师终于将灭绝外星人的神经扫描结果上传到了机器人中，结果十分令人惊喜。古代外星人已经彻底恢复了意识，并表达了要重建自己帝国的意愿。我们的驿站网络已标定了一颗可以作为他们新家园的星球。
texts.en: After many trials our engineers have finally managed to transfer the extinct aliens' neural scans to robotic bodies, and the results are exhilarating. The ancient aliens have fully regained consciousness and have expressed a desire to strike out on their own and rebuild their empire. Our Waystation network has charted a world that could serve as their new home.

label.zh: 让他们去我们驿站附近的一颗星球。
label.en: Direct them to a world near our Waystations.

texts.zh: 一个满载着各种数据存储设备的外星避难所，亟待考古学家恢复数据。
texts.en: An alien vault filled with data storage devices practically begs for some archaeological data recovery.

texts.zh: 通过将他们的神经扫描结果上传到到机器身体上，我们可以给这一灭绝的远古外星物种重获新生的机会。
texts.en: We could give an extinct species of ancient aliens a second chance at life by uploading their neural scans to robotic bodies.
